meta.name: finishing-a-development-branch
meta.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work

copy.tagline: 帮你决定开发分支的集成方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成功能开发并准备把代码合并到主分支
copy.tagline_en: Decide how to integrate your completed development work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have finished implementing a feature and need to merge your branch

howto.what: 在开发分支的工作完成后,Claude 会先跑项目完整测试套件,再检测 git 环境,列出合并回基底分支、推送并建 PR、原样保留等选项,按你的选择执行并清理工作区。
howto.when: 当实现已完成、所有测试通过,你需要决定如何整合这份工作时触发。测试未通过时它会先报告失败并停下,不给选项菜单。

say.text: 实现做完了测试也过了,帮我收尾这个分支
say.note: 它会先跑测试套件,再列出整合选项

say.text: 把这个分支合并回 base 分支,合并后重跑测试
say.note: 在本地合并、验证测试通过后清理工作区

say.text: 把这个分支推上去开一个 Pull Request
say.note: 推送分支、创建 PR,并保留 worktree

howto.what_en: Once the branch's work is done, Claude runs the full test suite, detects the git setup, then offers options (merge locally, open a PR, keep as-is) and executes your pick.
howto.when_en: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work. Failing tests are reported first, with no option menu.

say_en.text: Implementation's done and tests pass - help me wrap up this branch
say_en.note: It runs the suite, then lists integration options

say_en.text: Merge this branch back into base and re-run tests on the result
say_en.note: Merges locally, verifies tests, cleans up the worktree

say_en.text: Push this branch and open a pull request
say_en.note: Pushes, creates the PR, keeps the worktree
